note: BEFORE capture for the 12-14 Nov 2026 western disturbance. IQAir city pages and every station linked from them, History > Hourly, US AQI+ (column series of the visible History chart). Per city: 'city' = IQAir's city figure (a median of stations); rows = [slug, 'Station from' attribution, header interval (latest reading, local time), first category, last category, hourly values, error]. Categories are hour starts in local time (PKT for Pakistan, IST for India); value i is the hour starting at the first category on the date implied by the last category being the latest hour (47 values end 11 Nov 00:00 PKT / 00:30 IST; Delhi city has 48 values ending 01:30 IST). Empty = no reading. IQAir revises hours after first display.
method: User's Chrome: hidden iframes on each city and station URL; values read from options.series of the History .highcharts-container React props; dumped to the page as text and copied verbatim from the get_page_text result in the session transcript.
